messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a small but consistent spike of 429s from EU edge during today's v2 traffic shift. Deploybot shows step 2/5 in progress. Can we hold the roll for a quick check?

deploy-bot: Deploybot: v2 rollout started by @sam — traffic shifting 30% -> 50% across regions. To hold use `/deploybot hold 495876` or react :no_entry_sign:.

mira: @alex thanks. Can you paste an example request that got 429? suspect header negotiation or client signal.

alex: here's one i grabbed from logs — same bucket, repeated 429s within seconds:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "X-API-Version: 2" -H "User-Agent: client-sdk/1.2.0" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate
```

jen: We added a stricter schema check in v2 for the metadata header last week — clients older than 1.3 may not set the required header. Could be a mismatch.

sam: Release notes mention 1.3+ in migration, but we're still seeing lots of 1.2.0 traffic. Options: hold rollout, patch gateway to normalize header, or quick rollback. I prefer a gateway shim for <15m if ops agrees.

ben: ops-eyes here. If we hold, run this to pin routing: `/deploybot hold-rollout 4958764321 --reason "429 spike EU"`. We can also apply a gateway rewrite to keep traffic flowing. Gateway snippet below (fast patch):

```
# gateway fast patch
rewrite_rule:
  match: header "User-Agent" contains "client-sdk/1.2.0"
  set_header: "X-API-Version: 1"
```

mira: +1 to gateway shim. Also add temporary telemetry tag (e.g., rollout=paused-shim) so we can track client_version buckets separately.

alex: executing `/deploybot hold-rollout 4958764321` now.

deploy-bot: Action: Hold acknowledged by @alex. Rollout paused at 30% traffic. To resume use `/deploybot resume 495876` or wait for ops signoff. Logged: "Hold - 429 spike EU".

sam: I'll stage the gateway rewrite as a fast patch and update release notes to call out header normalization. ETA ~8-10m.

jen: If traffic doesn't normalize in 15m we should plan a rollback of v2 in EU. Keep eng-oncall looped if errors increase.

alex: thanks — attaching a quick prometheus query for ops to watch 429s by client_version:

```
sum(rate(api_responses{region="eu",status="429"}[5m])) by (client_version)
```

ben: ack — ops standing by. tagging @deploy-bot to log action :white_check_mark:.

sam: noted. Updating release notes and drafting a short customer advisory for enterprise tenants in EU.

mira: closing loop — once gateway rewrite is live we'll watch two consecutive 5m windows for drop in 429s and then remove shim after majority clients report >=1.3.0.

alex: will post an update when we see the first 5m window drop. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
